source_summary: Three GitHub Search API queries for newly created and recently pushed AI agent, MCP, browser, coding-agent, and workflow repositories produced 280 deduplicated candidates. Ten product-shaped repositories were audited through live repository metadata, root contents, and README responses saved under /tmp/radar_2026_09_22_api and /tmp/radar_2026_09_22_audit.
trend_observations: A single typed-decision model wave is rapidly being productized into concrete user surfaces: mobile reply assistance, macOS accessibility control, local evals, and software-factory orchestration. The durable differentiator is operational evidence: tests, signed releases, isolated sandboxes, explicit verification, permission prompts, or request-redaction boundaries—not merely a fast decision API.
assumptions: Scores use GitHub metadata and README/root-content evidence collected in this window. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, phone-tested, credential-tested, accessibility-permission-tested, model-connected, security-tested, or deployed locally. Star counts are point-in-time and should not be read as star deltas. Mature repositories surfaced by pushed activity were excluded unless their new product signal was distinct.

top_projects.summary: Android overlay assistant that reads supported chat screens, scores intent and risk, proposes replies, and leaves sending to the user.
top_projects.audience: People who want on-device assistance while composing messages in WeChat, QQ, X, or Feishu.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Turns local screen context into ranked reply options and explicit user-controlled handoff rather than autonomous sending.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-21, pushed 2026-09-22, 1,383 stars at audit; Android app, docs, APK, Gradle project, tooling, and device-tested claims are documented.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from a complete Kotlin/Gradle app, APK, screenshots, docs, and stated real-device coverage; no APK or accessibility flow was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Test on a spare Android device with a non-sensitive chat account; audit screen collection, overlay, and accessibility boundaries first.

top_projects.summary: Signed and notarized Apple Silicon menu-bar app that reads accessibility controls, acts on a focused app, and checks results with a stop shortcut.
top_projects.audience: macOS users who want bounded voice/text computer-use automation across accessible apps.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Combines a small decision model with the accessibility tree and visible stop control instead of opaque screenshot-only automation.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created and pushed 2026-09-19, 282 stars; root contains Swift sources, tests, resources, scripts, rebuild tooling, and a release install path.
top_projects.runnability: High from published notarized release, macOS requirements, Swift package, tests, and clear setup; no app, API key, or Accessibility permission was used.
top_projects.recommended_action: Use a non-destructive test app first and inspect what the accessibility tree exposes before granting broad permission.

top_projects.summary: Self-hosted coding-agent factory using Temporal and CubeSandbox microVMs to isolate work, verify changes, and retain patches plus execution evidence.
top_projects.audience: Engineering teams building governed autonomous implementation loops.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Makes agent delivery a durable workflow of task, sandbox, verification, patch, and evidence rather than a one-shot coding chat.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-19, pushed 2026-09-21, 86 stars; repo includes architecture/security docs, deploy assets, evals, examples, skills, tests, installer, and env example.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from Go project structure, installation material, CI, examples, evals, and deployment files; no Temporal, microVM, or agent loop was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Start with a disposable repository and verify sandbox cleanup, evidence retention, and failure recovery before connecting production SCM.

top_projects.summary: Local Python runtime for typed probabilistic decisions from an LLM without generated tokens, with schemas, benchmarks, examples, tests, and locked dependencies.
top_projects.audience: Agent builders needing inexpensive local routing, scoring, or classification decisions.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Moves constrained choice and probability decisions into a local, inspectable product surface instead of consuming full generative turns.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-21, pushed 2026-09-21, 225 stars; repo has request/response schemas, benchmarks, results, docs, examples, tests, and uv lockfile.
top_projects.runnability: High on paper from Python packaging, schemas, benchmarks, examples, and tests; no local model or benchmark was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Benchmark one routing decision against the current agent and inspect calibration, latency, and error costs before adoption.

top_projects.summary: Swift macOS app that turns voice or typed goals into accessibility-tree actions, with a build script, tests, resources, and permission-oriented setup.
top_projects.audience: Mac users who want hands-free or typed control of visible desktop tasks.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Uses structured next-action selection over the local accessibility tree, keeping interaction grounded in the currently visible UI.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-19, pushed 2026-09-21, 85 stars; root includes Swift sources, tests, docs, scripts, build.sh, and Package.swift.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from one-command build, no-dependency claim, source/tests, and explicit OS/permission requirements; no build or accessibility action was executed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Validate only reversible actions and audit keychain/API-key handling before enabling microphone or Accessibility access.

top_projects.summary: Rust proxy that scans LLM requests and attachments locally for secrets before forwarding supported OpenAI-compatible traffic.
top_projects.audience: Teams and individuals routing coding-agent prompts that may contain source files, attachments, or credentials.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats model-bound data as an inspectable policy boundary with OCR, redaction/blocking, cache, structured logs, rules, examples, and tests.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created and pushed 2026-09-20, 64 stars; root includes contracts, rules, examples, benches, docs, Nix setup, Rust sources, tests, and vendor material.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from a focused Rust package, tests, examples, configuration, and concrete proxy diagram; no model endpoint, attachment, or redaction rule was tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run against synthetic secrets and known-safe prompts, then evaluate false positives before placing it in a developer proxy path.

top_projects.summary: Python package for sending whole agent traces through inexpensive typed-decision evals and guardrails, supporting hosted and local decision backends.
top_projects.audience: Agent teams needing per-trace checks fast enough to keep inside their runtime loop.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Replaces a costly generative LLM judge with bounded decisions and makes evaluation an operational runtime component.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-20, pushed 2026-09-22, 48 stars; repo contains examples, Python package metadata, security/contribution docs, source, tests, and uv lockfile.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from package install docs, examples, tests, and explicit backend choices; no trace or local/hosted decision backend was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Replay a labeled trace set and compare alert quality, latency, and cost with the current evaluator before inline enforcement.

top_projects.summary: Rust/GPUI macOS client for viewing local Herdr terminal sessions, workspaces, Git worktrees, and agent activity.
top_projects.audience: Developers supervising local coding-agent sessions and worktrees.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Makes agent work observable in a native desktop surface tied to a local daemon and real developer artifacts.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-20, pushed 2026-09-22, 72 stars; repo offers CI, release/update docs, Homebrew material, crates, assets, security docs, and scripts.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from Rust workspace, release route, update docs, CI, and packaging assets; no daemon or macOS client was installed.
top_projects.recommended_action: Watch for a stable daemon-client quickstart; test session visibility and local-data retention in a throwaway workspace.

top_projects.summary: Local workstation for Claude Code and Codex collaboration with encrypted shared memory, messaging, handoffs, skills, and approval-gated nightly self-improvement.
top_projects.audience: Power users coordinating multiple coding-agent hosts on one machine.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Exposes cross-agent context and handoffs as locally owned, approval-gated operational primitives rather than hidden transcript copying.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-19, pushed 2026-09-22, 33 stars; root has apps, packages, docs, evals, tests, changelog, security material, and npm lockfile.
top_projects.runnability: Medium-high from monorepo, tests/evals, security docs, and explicit no-daemon/local-first framing; no installation, encryption, or cross-agent handoff was tested.
top_projects.recommended_action: Audit encrypted-memory semantics and approval prompts with fake projects before exposing real agent session data.

top_projects.summary: Unofficial Rust terminal reimplementation of a Claude Code-style coding assistant with bilingual docs, tests, and a justfile.
top_projects.audience: Developers exploring alternative terminal UX for coding-agent workflows.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Packages a familiar terminal-agent loop in a compiled, inspectable local client with tests and development tooling.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-09-20, pushed 2026-09-21, 462 stars; root includes Cargo workspace files, bilingual READMEs, source, tests, justfile, and AGPL-3.0 license.
top_projects.runnability: Medium from Rust project/test structure and documentation; no provider setup, build, or repository edit loop was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Treat as an experimental client; verify provider compatibility, data handling, and license fit before team use.

watchlist.summary: Local macOS Accessibility-based form automation for a specialized computer-use model.
watchlist.audience: Teams testing private local form completion.
watchlist.ai_native_angle: Binds an on-device model to deterministic accessibility actions.
watchlist.recommended_action: Await audited privacy and failure-mode documentation.

watchlist.summary: VS Code-local search over Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode chats using reranking.
watchlist.ai_native_angle: Makes cross-host agent history queryable in the editor.
watchlist.recommended_action: Check local data boundaries and index deletion behavior.

watchlist.summary: TypeScript gateway targeting MCP interoperability with Open WebUI.
watchlist.audience: Teams exposing MCP tools to OpenAPI-oriented surfaces.
watchlist.ai_native_angle: Makes agent tool capability portable across protocol boundaries.
watchlist.recommended_action: Promote after auth and schema fidelity are demonstrated.

watchlist.summary: Local mock provider for deterministic OpenAI and Anthropic-shaped responses.
watchlist.audience: Agent teams testing without paid model calls.
watchlist.ai_native_angle: Separates agent integration tests from live stochastic provider behavior.
watchlist.recommended_action: Watch for contract fixtures and failure simulation coverage.

watchlist.summary: Self-hosted git-backed team knowledge bundles over MCP.
watchlist.audience: Teams controlling context size for coding agents.
watchlist.ai_native_angle: Treats context delivery as a budgeted, inspectable compile step.
watchlist.recommended_action: Promote after retrieval provenance and stale-context controls are tested.

skipped_projects.skip_reason: Curated list, not a runnable product.
Workflow collection with insufficient distinct product surface.
Agent RL research project rather than end-user product tooling.
Document-generation use case needs stronger abuse controls before inclusion.
Likely unauthorized commercial-software distribution, not a product candidate.
Useful local utility but agent functionality is optional and product evidence is limited.
